_comment__file_purpose: Controls template generation by rendering CAD models from multiple viewpoints and in-plane rotations.

gen_templates_opts._comment__version: Internal config schema version used by FoundPose.
gen_templates_opts._comment__object_dataset: Logical dataset name. Used for directory structure, caching, and bookkeeping.
gen_templates_opts._comment__object_lids: List of object IDs (LIDs) to generate templates for. Useful when datasets contain multiple objects.
gen_templates_opts._comment__num_viewspheres: Number of view-spheres used for camera sampling. 1 = uniform sampling over a single sphere.
gen_templates_opts._comment__min_num_viewpoints: Minimum number of camera viewpoints sampled on the view-sphere. Higher improves pose coverage but increases compute.
gen_templates_opts._comment__num_inplane_rotations: Number of in-plane rotations per viewpoint to capture rotational ambiguity around the camera optical axis.
gen_templates_opts._comment__images_per_view: Number of rendered images per (viewpoint × in-plane rotation). Usually 1 unless randomness is enabled.
gen_templates_opts._comment__max_num_triangles: Maximum triangle count allowed in the mesh. Meshes are decimated above this threshold to speed up rendering.
gen_templates_opts._comment__back_face_culling: If true, triangles facing away from the camera are discarded. False is safer for thin or concave objects.
gen_templates_opts._comment__texture_size: Resolution of texture maps used during rendering. Larger improves visual fidelity at the cost of memory.
gen_templates_opts._comment__ssaa_factor: Super-sampling anti-aliasing factor. Values >1 improve edge quality but increase render time.
gen_templates_opts._comment__background_type: Background color or style for rendered templates. Black reduces feature contamination.
gen_templates_opts._comment__light_type: Lighting configuration. Multi-directional lighting improves robustness to real-world illumination changes.
gen_templates_opts._comment__features_patch_size: Patch size used by the feature extractor backbone. Must be consistent with the ViT configuration.
gen_templates_opts._comment__crop: Whether rendered images are cropped around the object bounding box. False keeps full-frame renders.
gen_templates_opts._comment__crop_rel_pad: Relative padding added around the object when cropping is enabled.
gen_templates_opts._comment__crop_size: Final resolution (width, height) after cropping. Only used if crop=true.
